description: Traffic Volume is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. This data shows traffic volumes for freeways (excluding toll roads) and arterial roads in Victoria. The annual average daily traffic volume is provided, including the number of commercial vehicles. The data provided is for the current year, with values derived from traffic surveys or estimates. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are Traffic, Traffic Open Data. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
